high_level_description: The image is a combination of text and a photograph. The text provides an interesting fact about the actor Steve McQueen. It states that he had a habit of demanding free items in bulk from studios when agreeing to do a film, such as electric razors, jeans, and other supplies. It was later discovered that he donated these items to the Boys Republic reformatory school, where he had spent part of his teenage years. Below the text, there is a black-and-white photograph of Steve McQueen.
